reason: Agent Lightning PR #362 exact head 30d4178cf6cc6d535b8baa9e9a38110ccacf5bb7 has GREEN Linux, ACV2, WP-A, shared regressions and CodeRabbit checks, while Stage 6.4.5.9 run 31770185550 fails in wp0-route before WP0 at Establish exact base-owned route policy with exit 128 after checkout and exact diff-range resolution. The Stage workflow creates a detached full base worktree; current main tracks both the pinned Electron v39.8.5 Windows archive and rcedit through Git LFS. A full worktree therefore invokes LFS smudge for unrelated binary custody and is structurally unsafe when the repository LFS budget is exhausted. Merely setting lfs:false or GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE would move or mask the same failure and is prohibited. This successor authorizes two coupled root repairs: (1) preserve base-owned WP0 routing while replacing full base worktree materialization with an exact-base minimal Git-object export containing only the trusted route selector dependencies, executed against the candidate repository object database; and (2) retire Yance Git-LFS custody for the exact Electron v39.8.5 win32-x64 archive, materializing that same official asset from the upstream electron/electron v39.8.5 GitHub Release and failing closed on pinned asset identity, byte size and SHA-256. The existing rcedit LFS custody remains unchanged and outside scope.
